About us

Get to know Dr. Heidi Oster MD, PC.

Our story

Nearly 20 years of women's health in Colorado

Dr. Heidi Oster, MD graduated from UCLA School of Medicine in 1988 and completed her residency at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center. For almost 20 years, she has provided Colorado women with friendly, compassionate care across every life stage—from puberty through geriatrics. Dr. Oster is certified in robotic surgery using the da Vinci® Surgical System and leads a team of skilled Nurse Practitioners and clinical staff who have built strong relationships with patients, colleagues, and health care facilities.
